name: Inward Loyalty Rewards Hub
author: Inscript

sections.description:
Inward Loyalty Rewards Hub transforms your WooCommerce store into an engaging, repeat-purchase driver. Reward customers with points for spending, completing orders, and unlocking exclusive membership tiers (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum).

Key Features:

  • Custom Points Earning Ratio: Configure how many points customers earn per unit of currency spent (e.g. 1 Point per 100 LKR).
  • Multi-Tier Customer Levels: Create Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Platinum tiers with dynamic point multiplier bonuses.
  • Instant Checkout Redemption: Allow customers to convert points into discount coupons directly on the WooCommerce checkout & cart page via AJAX.
  • My Account Loyalty Hub: Dedicated customer portal displaying current balance, tier progress bar, redeemable rewards, and full transaction history.
  • Admin Analytics & Management: Complete dashboard with metrics, search/filter customer points balances, transaction logs, and manual points adjustment.
  • Sticky Admin UI Header: Modern, sleek interface with fixed top navigation for effortless browsing across long reports.
sections.installation:
1. Upload inward-loyalty-rewards-hub folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Navigate to ‘Inward Loyalty’ in the WordPress admin sidebar to configure your earning rules, tiers, and rewards.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, Inward Loyalty Rewards Hub relies on WooCommerce for order processing, customer accounts, and coupon redemptions.

Can I manually adjust customer points?

Yes! Store administrators can credit or debit points directly from the Customer Points admin screen with audit logging.

screenshots.caption: Admin Loyalty Dashboard – Real-time analytics overview showing total points issued, redemptions, member counts, redemption velocity, and activity trends.
Customer Loyalty Directory – Search, inspect, and adjust customer loyalty balances, lifetime points, and membership tier levels.
Points Audit Trail & Logs – Comprehensive ledger of all points earned, redeemed, and admin-adjusted with order references and status filters.
Promotional Banners Customizer – Configure customizable banner alerts for Cart, Checkout, and Thank You pages with live preview and merge tags.
Loyalty Settings & Custom Rules – Configure earn/redemption ratios, currency labels, unlock thresholds, and custom promo rules (reviews, signup bonus).
Customer Loyalty Hub (My Account) – Personalized customer portal featuring current points balance, tier progress bar, multiplier badges, and earning guide.
Voucher Redemption Portal – Allows customers to convert points into instant WooCommerce discount coupons or claim featured vouchers.
Customer Transaction History – Transparent points activity ledger allowing customers to view past earnings, coupon redemptions, and related orders.
